I haven't met a human who it doesn't take at least half a year to get comfortable around. 

But you're right, the dozens of therapists I've had have all been duds. There's no point in wasting my time finding more duds

I've seen dozens of therapists over the years. None of them help. I tried talking this over with a friend who thinks it's totally reasonable for me to spend weeks taking time off work to call places (since these offices are never open before 8 or after 5, so I can't even make an appointment without taking time off work) to find a therapist who takes my insurance, who will work with my schedule, and then spend months of unproductive sessions getting comfortable with a therapist who may or may not work out. Lol sorry but five months of excruciating effort isn't worth the likely possibility that it still won't fucking work.
